senses.gloss: f.(b. h., √אב, comp. אבר , v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.) stone.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 10a:8">Sabb. 10ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 12b:5">Pes. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>כזורק א׳ וכ׳</he> like throwing a stone into a leather bottle (has no effect, or is indigestible).
Num. R. s. 22 (prov.) into a well out of which you drank אל תזרוק בו א׳ cast no stone.—א׳ טובה jewel.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 16b:12">B. Bath. 16ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. Pl. <he>אֲבָנִים</he>, const. <cite ref="A00434"><he>אַבְנֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:14">Gen. R. s. 68</cite> <he>שנים עשרה א׳</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:14">Ib.</cite> <he>אם מתאחות הן שלשה א׳</he> (read <cite ref="U01387"><he>שלש</he></cite>) if these three stones shall grow into one; a. fr.

senses.gloss: Stone Chamber, name of a Temple compartment.
units: Parah III, 1.—א׳ גליון, v. אָוֶן.—א׳ הטועים (א׳ טועין, א׳ טוען, v. טָעָה) Stone of Losers (Claims), a place in Jerusalem where lost and found things were deposited and claimed.
Taan. III, 8; Y. ib. 66ᵈ bot.; B. Mets. 28ᵇ—א׳ המבר or א׳ המקח auction place (for slaves).
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 26:10">Sifré Deut. 26</cite>. Sifra B’har ch. VII, s. 6.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 667:7">Yalk. Lev. 667</cite> <he>א׳ הלקח</he>.—<he>א׳ מסמא</he> a stone used for closing a pit etc.

Nidd. 69ᵇ בא׳ מ׳ the corpse was put on a closing (immovable) stone; a. e.—קבועה א׳ a stone rooted in the ground, opp. תלושה. Y. Sotah IX, 23ᶜ top.—אבני השדה v. אדני.—שׁוֹאֶבֶת א׳ magnetic stone, load-stone.
Snh. 107ᵇ; a. e.—א׳ הַשָּׁעוֹת stone-dial, Kel. XII, 4; a. e.—א׳ שְׁתִיָּה foundation stone, stone Sh’thiya which in the second Temple occupied the place of the Holy Arc.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:2">Yoma V, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:3">3</cite>); v.
Ib. a. l.—אבנים תּוֹשָׁבוֹת immigrant stones, i.e. stones brought over from another ground.
Ib. a. l.—א׳ תלושה v. sup. א׳ קבועה.—א׳ תקומה preserving stone, a stone believed to protect against abortion.
<cite ref="Shabbat 66b:7">Sabb. 66ᵇ</cite>.—[For other combinations see respective determinants.]
